ns2:course.label: Introduction to Neurobiology
ns2:course.description: (PHYSL 309) Introduction to the physiology of nerve cells, mechanisms of neural integration, and the organization of sensory and motor systems; also introduces neurochemistry, neuroendocrinology, neural development, neural plasticity, and the physiological basis of behavior. Same as NEUR 404. Prerequisite: MCB 252 or consent of instructor.
